source_evidence_status.rbi_91_day_tbill: Three official RBI Handbook auction tables (Table 213, Table 217 and Table 218) cover 2023-07-12 through 2026-06-24. The 60-row Table 213 panel has 60 matched notices/results; its overlap with Table 217 has 9 dates, and Table 217/218 overlap on 5 dates, with all overlap fields matching. The deduplicated source panel has 151 auction dates, 149 positive 91-day price observations and two zero-issue exceptions. Four Table 213 issue dates conflict with their contemporaneous notices; both values are retained and the notice governs normalized issue date. A bounded date audit reconciles all 60 Table 213 notice settlement dates and verifies RBI's 2023-09-29 G-Sec market-open exception despite a Mumbai NI Act holiday. Four nominal issue+91-day maturities fall on listed Mumbai holidays. Because the holiday matrix is not a complete G-Sec operational calendar, no maturity adjustment or 2023-2024 maturity-to-bid transition is qualified. This panel describes auction quote levels and is not a 2014-2026 rollover history or long-run risk sample. The separate v2 rollover mechanics audit remains scoped to 2024-2026: it verifies RBI Retail Direct rules, 98 observed settlement dates against captured Mumbai holidays, 86 maturity-to-bid transitions (5-21 day waits; median 6; 12 right-censored), and a conditional 365-day scenario with 59 complete / 39 censored cohorts and gross annualized values 4.8466%-5.9502% (median 5.3678%). It assumes full allotment and excludes upfront markup, payment-gateway charges, partial allocation, bank cash yield, tax and investor-specific access. The reconstructed 2023-2024 capture manifest explicitly states that HTTP response headers were not retained during the earlier validation-stopped capture; body hashes and dates are independently checked. Long-run risk, covariance and 2036 probability remain unqualified.
source_evidence_status.direct_goi: Official Gazette notice and RBI full auction-result bytes for 6.94% GS 2036 are hash-verified in draft PR #65; one primary-auction price/yield, notice-specific accrued-interest cutoff and nominal coupon/redemption schedule are reconciled. No current executable secondary price, retail settlement advice, or continuous security price history is qualified. NSE WDM historical data is a paid licensed route (2026 tariff ₹30,000/year/site before taxes); rights and scope remain unconfirmed. The RBI long-history yield panel remains a proxy, not this security trade-return history.
